title: MembershipCredential credential subject
description: The credential subject of an MDS MembershipCredential, as validated by a verifier that resolves the credentialSchema of the presented credential. Backs the Membership and ParticipantId policy operands of profile version 2026/1.

id.description: The holder's did:web DID. MUST equal the DID that authenticates in the presentation exchange. The ParticipantId policy operand is evaluated against it.
